title: Prosocial Behavior Detection in Player Game Chat: From Aligning Human-AI Definitions to Efficient Annotation at Scale
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a classification pipeline for detecting prosocial behavior in game chat. While prosocial behavior is related to positive social values, the paper treats it as a content moderation and annotation task, focusing on alignment and cost-efficiency rather than evaluating moral, ethical, or religious reasoning systems.
